title: Period (closing the books)
summary: Closing the books per company: a date through which every area, or one area (sales, purchasing, payroll …), is closed, so documents dated in it are neither posted nor cancelled; reopening needs its own permission and a reason, audited. The fiscal year's first month per company. Offers PeriodClient.
when_to_use: Documents are posted (invoices, receipts, payslips, stock moves) and a month, once reported, must not change.
when_not_to_use: Only master data, no posted documents.
A lock that nobody may ever reopen (a hard lock) — not in this version.

permissions.description: Menutup buku dan mengatur tahun buku

permissions.description: Membuka kembali buku yang sudah ditutup
